turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
checkout total.
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
If you mean the Mini Mod Warmer with wax melts, start with 1–2 wax bears in its silicone dish. You can choose a 3-, 6-, or 9-hour timer setting for how long you want it to run.
For cleanup, let the wax cool and harden before removing the silicone dish and popping the wax into the waste bin. Wipe the dish with warm water between uses.
If you meant a different warmer, tell me which one—our recommended amount of wax varies by model.
